name: H100 NVL
notes: UNRESOLVED SOURCE DISCREPANCY, flagged rather than silently resolved: the values recorded here (per-card: FP64=30, FP32=60, TF32=835*, BF16/FP16=1671*, FP8/INT8=3341*) come from the live nvidia.com/en-us/data-center/h100/ product page's 2-column SXM-vs-NVL table. A separate NVIDIA-authored 3-column (SXM/PCIe/NVL) datasheet, mirrored via a partner site (pny.com), states figures for the bridged 2-card PAIR (FP64=68, FP32=134, TF32=1979*, BF16/FP16=3958*, FP8/INT8=7916* TOPS) that, when halved for a single card, equal SXM's per-GPU numbers exactly (34/67/67/989/1979/1979/3958/3958) -- NOT matching the live page's lower per-card NVL figures. Since H100 NVL is power-capped well below SXM (400W max vs SXM's 700W), it is physically implausible for NVL to match SXM's full compute rate; the live nvidia.com page's lower, TDP-consistent figures are treated as authoritative here, but this conflict is not fully resolved and should be re-verified against a directly-fetched nvidia.com/resources.nvidia.com PDF (not a partner mirror) before publishing. 'H100 NVL' is NOT a single fused/bonded board -- it is two individually-installed H100 NVL PCIe cards that must be connected via 3 separate NVLink bridge connectors to operate as the marketed 'NVL' pair; nvlink_bridge_gpu_count/nvlink_max_domain_size set to 2 to reflect this fixed pairing (distinct from H200 NVL's variable 2-way/4-way bridging, see h200-nvl-141gb.json). Memory bandwidth of 3,938 GB/s and bus width of 6,016 bits are per-card figures from the H100 NVL Product Brief; the live page rounds bandwidth to '3.9TB/s'. tensor_cores/cuda_cores/sm_count left null: not explicitly stated for the NVL SKU in any source checked (plausibly identical to SXM's 528/16,896/132 given matching architecture, but not NVIDIA-confirmed for NVL specifically, so not recorded as sourced fact). TDP marketed as '350-400W (configurable)' per card; 400W recorded as max. MIG: up to 7 instances @ 12GB each per card.

_sources.memory_capacity_gb: https://www.nvidia.com/content/dam/en-zz/Solutions/Data-Center/h100/PB-11773-001_v01.pdf (H100 NVL Product Brief, Table 2: 'Memory type HBM3, Memory size 94 GB')
_sources.nvlink_bandwidth_gbps: https://www.nvidia.com/content/dam/en-zz/Solutions/Data-Center/h100/PB-11773-001_v01.pdf (Table 6: 3 NVLink bridges, 48 total Rx/Tx lanes, 100 Gbps/lane, 600 GB/s total)
